title: Arabic Offensive Language on Twitter: Analysis and Experiments
benchmark_measurement: Detection of religious hate speech as a sub-category of offensive language in Arabic tweets.
findings: Religious hate speech was a measured category of offensive language. It was found to be a less dominant topic for offensive language compared to sports and politics, appearing in only 15% of all hate speech tweets within the created dataset.
